messages:
tasha: Morning — quick async standup. TL;DR: landed adaptive micro-batching kernel change and tweaked slot allocator.

What I did yesterday: landed kernel patch that dynamically adjusts micro-batch windows; ran synthetic microburst bench across 3k-seq workload. Observed p95 ~12% improvement and 6% mean improvement on GPU pool A.

Blocker: seeing OOMs on node3 when KV prefetch exceeds ~5k entries. CI on that node fails intermittently with `OOMKilled` in eviction worker. Repro locally but need better repro case.

Today: repro the eviction leak locally, add guardrails (prefetch cap + circuit breaker), open PR for canary, and kick off a staging canary.

aj: nice wins. Any logs or reproducer you can drop here?

maya: congrats on perf. For the KV OOM, did you try temporarily lowering prefetch window (PREFETCH_MAX) to see behavior?

tasha: tried PREFETCH_MAX=2000 — reduces OOM frequency but increases latency for some small bursts. suspect evict path race with async frees.

aj: can you paste the failing trace/snippet?

tasha: ````
# run used
./tools/run_local.sh --profile=microburst --nodes=1 --seq=3000

[evict-worker] ERROR: failed to free kv-entry id=0x7f9b3c size=8192: runtime: out of memory
stack: goroutine 72 [running]:
runtime.throw(0x4f2b6b, 0x1a)
	/usr/local/go/src/runtime/panic.go:1116 +0x72
	...
````

kevin: ping me on the PR when you open it, I'll review asap. Also, can we add a flaky-test skip for that CI gate so it doesn't block rollouts? @tasha :thumbsup:

tasha: yeah I'll add a skip + a stress job to the canary. Plan to run `./tools/bench --suite=microburst --runs=10` in CI for the kernel+kv branches.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: `kernel/microburst-evict-fix` -> staging (build #1478). :rocket:

ron: I'm re-running the long 3k-seq job now with `kv-evict-fix` branch + latest kernel. Will post numbers in ~30m.

maya: product asked if this is user-visible — any curl-level impact?

tasha: minimal user-facing changes; endpoint latency should slightly improve for bursty inputs. No API changes.

aj: landed a small doc update for batching heuristics, no blockers from my side.

maya: ok cool. If anyone needs help repro-ing the leak locally ping me, I can pair.

tasha: thanks — will update thread with PR link and bench artifacts. :eyes:
